name: rpi-head-unit
description: RootUnit — a themeable, animated car head unit for Raspberry Pi 5: web UI + Node backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @headunit/server" "npm run dev -w @headunit/ui"
scripts.build: node deploy/fetch-librespot.mjs && npm run build -w @headunit/ui && npm run build -w @headunit/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @headunit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @headunit/server && npm run typecheck -w @headunit/ui
scripts.test: npm run test -w @headunit/server && npm run test -w @headunit/ui
